display.purpose: One platform-boundary statement per first viewport.

body.purpose: Calm explanatory copy with an intentionally readable measure.

shadows.name: proof-panel
shadows.purpose: Lifts the current-proof instrument from the page field.

components.name: Synthetic Runtime Status
components.description: Non-interactive disclosure of the current execution boundary.
components.css: .ds-status { border: 1px solid oklch(0.885 0.015 265); border-radius: 999px; color: oklch(0.48 0.025 267); font: 650 12px/1.2 'Avenir Next', Avenir, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; padding: 7px 11px; }

components.name: Capability Marker
components.description: A compact sequence marker for independently auditable foundation capabilities.
components.css: .ds-marker { align-items: center; background: oklch(0.94 0.045 270); border-radius: 8px; color: oklch(0.49 0.19 270); display: inline-flex; font: 700 12px/1 'Avenir Next', Avenir, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; height: 36px; justify-content: center; width: 36px; }

narrative.overview: A quiet control-room surface that makes a platform foundation auditable without borrowing the visual language of a live marketplace.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Indigo communicates active meaning, focus, and status rather than decoration.

dos: Do lead with the runtime boundary.
donts: Don't imply live providers or commerce.
Don't organize the page as a generic icon-card grid.
